bio_en: Sargis Ohanjanian, pen-name Farhat, was born in 1868 in Vagharshapat into a poor family and left the Gevorgian seminary after one year to work. In 1893-95 he went to Persia, where he worked with Nikol Duman, Ishkhan Arghutian, Karo Zorian, Sevkaretsi Sako, Peto and Hovnan Davtian in the ARF's 1890s network. Besides party work he wrote for Mshak and above all Droshak under the name Farhat. He later worked in Constantinople, left after Zavarian's death for the Caucasus, and died of typhus in poverty on 25 December 1918.
